segments.name: Electric Company
segments.description: Generates, transmits, distributes and sells electric energy in Oklahoma and western Arkansas.
segments.evidence: OGE Energy's electric company operations are conducted through its wholly-owned subsidiary, OG&E, which generates, transmits, distributes and sells electric energy in Oklahoma and western Arkansas and are reported through OGE Energy's electric company business segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay regulated rates for retail electricity service through tariffs regulated by state and federal regulators.
revenueModel.evidence: OG&E's retail electric tariffs are regulated by the OCC in Oklahoma and by the APSC in Arkansas.

changes.text: In 2022, OGE Energy exited its former midstream business by selling all equity securities of Energy Transfer.
changes.evidence: OGE Energy exited its former midstream business in 2022 as a result of selling all equity securities of Energy Transfer that were previously held by OGE Energy.
